statusLine.description: ECC usage bar: 5h/7d rate-limit bars + cache | model, context, cost | ECC version, hooks, plugins

_comments.setup: Installed automatically by the ECC installer (launcher at ~/.claude/ecc-statusline.js). For manual setup, replace <plugin-root> with your ECC installation path.
_comments.display: Three lines: (1) 5h/7d rate-limit usage bars with reset countdowns and prompt-cache hit rate, (2) model with effort/fast badges, context bar, session cost, lines changed, duration, current task, (3) ECC version, hooks profile, enabled plugins with versions, directory.
_comments.output_example: 5h ███████░ 84% ↻1h54m │ 7d █░░░░░░░ 14% ↻4d │ cache 100% \n Opus 5 xhigh │ ctx █░░░░░░░░░ 13% 1M │ $7.85 +49/-49 36m │ Fixing auth bug \n ECC 2.2.0 │ hooks standard │ plugins ecc 2.2.0 · swift-lsp 1.0.0 │ myproject
_comments.compact_mode: Set ECC_STATUSLINE_COMPACT=1 for the legacy single-line format.
_comments.dependencies: Rate-limit line requires a subscription session. Cost/duration segments read the bridge file from ecc-metrics-bridge.js PostToolUse hook.
_comments.usage: Copy the statusLine object to your ~/.claude/settings.json
